request: fourteen plants on the balcony and roof and i water them all or none. each plant has how often it needs water, a tap when watered, and a list of which ones are thirsty today versus fine for now with days until the next watering
checklist: 1. add a plant with spot and watering interval
4. days until next watering for the rest
program:
app "Plants" plant green
table plant name text, spot pick Balcony|Living|Kitchen|Roof = Living, every num 1..30 = 4 unit "days"
table water plant ref plant
topbar "Plants", plant, "Add plant"
statcard count(plant, due(it.water, it.every)), "plants are thirsty of" count(plant), count(plant)
section "Thirsty today"
  each plant sort name as p
    if due(p.water, p.every)
      row gap 2 tap edit p
        stack grow gap 0
          p.name bold
          p.spot faint
        button "Watered" fill accent tap add water plant = p
section "Fine for now"
  each plant sort name as p empty "No plants yet. Add the first one."
    if not due(p.water, p.every)
      row gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
        p.name grow
        "in" p.every - since(p.water) "days" faint

request: three kids in three schools and the fee dates are all over the place. add each child, then each term fee with amount and due date, tick when paid, show what is overdue and how much each child still owes. remind me three days before
checklist: 2. add a fee with term, amount and due date
5. reminder three days before the due date
program:
app "School fees" school blue
table kid name text
table fee kid ref kid, term text, amount money, due date, paid bool
remind "A school fee is due soon" at fee.due - 3d at 9:00
topbar "School fees", fee, "Add fee"
statcard sum(fee.amount where paid = no), "unpaid," count(fee where paid = no and due < today) "overdue"
each kid sort name as k empty "No children yet. Add a name below, then the first fee."
  stack card gap 1
    row gap 2
      k.name head grow
      sum(k.fee.amount where paid = no) "still due" faint
    each k.fee sort due as f
      row gap 2 tap edit f swipe remove f
        toggle f.paid
        stack grow gap 0
          f.term bold
          f.due faint color if(f.paid = no and f.due < today, bad, muted)
        f.amount
form kid, "Add child"

request: school sends so many notices. i add the event with its date, whether it needs a permission slip, whether i signed it, and any money to send. show the ones this week, unsigned slips in red, and remind me the evening before
checklist: 1. add an event with date, slip needed and signed flags and money
program:
app "School events" school purple
table event what text, held date, slip bool, signed bool, money money?
remind "A school event is tomorrow" at event.held - 1d at 18:00
let unsigned = count(event where slip = yes and signed = no and held >= today)
topbar "School events", event, "Add event"
statcard unsigned, "slips still to sign"
section "Next 7 days"
  each event where held >= today and held < today + 7 sort held as e empty "Nothing at school this week."
    row gap 2 tap edit e
      stack grow gap 0
        e.what bold
        e.held faint
      if e.slip
        toggle e.signed
      e.money faint
each event where held >= today + 7 sort held as e
  row card gap 2 tap edit e swipe remove e
    e.what grow
    e.held faint color if(e.slip and e.signed = no, bad, muted)

request: we bought a delivery bike for 320000 and expect to sell it for 80000 after 5 years. type the price, the resale value and the years, show how much value it loses each year and what it is worth after the year i choose
program:
app "Bike Value" bike slate
state cost money = 320000
state scrap money = 80000
state life num = 5
state yr num = 2
let per = if(life > 0, (cost - scrap) / life, 0)
field cost "Purchase price"
field scrap "Resale value at the end"
"Years of use" life faint
slider life 1..15
statcard round(per), "lost each year"
"Value after year" yr round(max(cost - per * yr, scrap)) bold
slider yr 0..15

request: i am making up old prayers. for each of fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha and witr i put how many i owe, then tap each time i pray one as qaza. show how many are left for each and in total
checklist: 1. add how many prayers owed for each prayer
2. tap when one qaza prayer is made up
program:
app "Qaza prayers" mosque slate
table qaza prayer pick Fajr|Dhuhr|Asr|Maghrib|Isha|Witr = Fajr, kind pick Owed|Prayed = Owed, qty num 1..9999 = 1
let left(p text) = sum(qaza.qty where prayer = p and kind = Owed) - sum(qaza.qty where prayer = p and kind = Prayed)
topbar "Qaza prayers", qaza, "Add or log"

each options qaza.prayer as p

    stack grow gap 0
      p bold
      left(p) "left" faint
    button "Made up one" fill accent tap add qaza prayer = p, kind = Prayed, qty = 1

request: how many cashiers do i keep at the counter in the rush hour. customers arrive per hour, each cashier serves a customer in a number of minutes, and i want cashiers busy at most 80 percent of the time so queues stay short
checklist: 5. how busy each cashier would be
program:
app "Cashier Count" users yellow
state cust num = 90
state mins num = 3
state busy num = 80
let load = cust * mins / 60
let need = (0 - floor(0 - (load * 100 / max(busy, 1))))
field cust "Customers per hour"
"Minutes to serve one customer" mins faint
slider mins 1..15
"Keep cashiers busy at most" busy "%" faint
slider busy 40..100
statcard need, "cashiers needed"
"Each would be busy" round(load * 100 / max(need, 1)) "% of the hour." faint
grid 6 gap 1
  each 1..min(need, 12)
    box height 28 radius 6 fill accent

request: two home tutors and one academy. each has a monthly fee. tick paid for this month, show how much tuition is still unpaid this month and how many tutors i paid in each of the last six months
checklist: 1. add a tutor with subject and monthly fee

request: before we repeat a campaign, work out the return. add each campaign with what it cost and the revenue it brought, and show roi percent for each and for all of them together, and which campaign was best
checklist: 1. add a campaign with cost and revenue
program:
app "Campaign ROI" chart red
table camp name text, spent money, earned money
let roi(c camp) = if(c.spent > 0, (c.earned - c.spent) * 100 / c.spent, 0)
let allspent = sum(camp.spent)
topbar "Campaign ROI", camp, "Add campaign"
row gap 2
  statcard round(if(allspent > 0, (sum(camp.earned) - allspent) * 100 / allspent, 0)), "% combined ROI"
  statcard round(max(camp, roi(it))), "% best campaign"
section "Return by campaign"
  share camp sort roi(it) desc, round(roi(it)), it.name
section "Campaigns"
  list camp, "No campaigns yet. Add the cost and what it brought in."

request: money goes between me, my brothers and cousins and nobody remembers. person, amount, lent or borrowed, a promised return date, and a tick when it came back. net amount at the top, overdue ones in red
checklist: 1. add a loan with person, amount, lent or borrowed and return date
program:
app "Family loans" money slate
table loan person text, amount money, kind pick Lent|Borrowed = Lent, due date?, returned bool
let net = sum(loan.amount where kind = Lent and returned = no) - sum(loan.amount where kind = Borrowed and returned = no)
topbar "Family loans", loan, "Add loan"
statcard net, if(net >= 0, "owed to me net", "I owe net")
"Overdue:" count(loan where returned = no and due < today) head color if(count(loan where returned = no and due < today) > 0, bad, ink)
each loan where returned = no by person as g empty "Nothing is out. All settled."
  stack card gap 1
    row
      g.key head grow
      sum(g.amount) faint
    each g as l
      row gap 2 tap edit l swipe remove l
        toggle l.returned
        stack grow gap 0
          l.kind l.amount bold
          l.due faint color if(l.due < today, bad, muted)

request: i am chasing unpaid invoices. add each one with the client, amount and due date, and show how much is not due yet, how much is up to 30 days late, and how much is over 30 days late, plus the total owed
checklist: 1. add an unpaid invoice with amount and due date
program:
app "Invoice Ageing" note red
table inv client text, amount money, due date
let notdue = sum(inv.amount where due >= today)
let late1 = sum(inv, if(today - it.due > 0 and today - it.due <= 30, it.amount, 0))
let late2 = sum(inv, if(today - it.due > 30, it.amount, 0))
topbar "Invoice Ageing", inv, "Add invoice"
statcard sum(inv.amount), "total owed to me"
row gap 2
  statcard notdue, "not due yet"
  statcard late1, "1 to 30 days late"
  statcard late2, "over 30 days late"
section "Invoices", "Count:" count(inv)
  each inv sort it.due as i empty "No unpaid invoices. Add one when you send it."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      i.client grow
      i.amount bold
      if i.due < today
        (today - i.due) "days late" faint color bad
      else
        "due" i.due faint

request: logo design quote. a base price covers 2 rounds of changes, every extra revision costs more, and rush delivery adds a percent. type the number of revisions i expect and whether it is rush and give me the quote i send
program:
app "Design Quote" pen purple
state base money = 15000
state incl num = 2
state extra money = 2500
state revs num = 4
state rush pick Normal|Rush = Normal
let extras = max(revs - incl, 0) * extra
let sub = base + extras
let quote = if(rush = Rush, sub * 1.3, sub)
field base "Base price"
field extra "Price per extra revision"
"Revisions I expect" revs faint
slider revs 0..12
choice rush
statcard round(quote), "quote to send"
"Base" base ", extra revisions" extras faint
if rush = Rush
  "Rush adds 30%:" round(quote - sub) faint

request: estimate our monthly cloud bill before we launch. a server costs so much per hour and i run a number of them all month, storage costs per gb, and data going out costs per gb. type my usage and show each part of the bill and the total, and what it is per user
checklist: 4. each part of the bill and total
program:
app "Cloud Bill" cloud purple
state srv num = 2
state sprice money = 12
state store num = 500
state gprice money = 3
state egress num = 800
state eprice money = 6
state users num = 1000
let a = srv * sprice * 720
let b = store * gprice
let c = egress * eprice
field srv "Servers running all month"
field sprice "Price per server hour"
field store "Storage (GB)"
field gprice "Price per GB stored"
field egress "Data out (GB)"
field eprice "Price per GB out"
section "Bill", "Total" round(a + b + c)
  "Servers" round(a) faint
  "Storage" round(b) faint
  "Data out" round(c) faint
"Users" users faint
slider users 10..100000
"That is" round((a + b + c) * 100 / max(users, 1)) / 100 "per user per month." bold

request: leaking tap, broken fan, roof seepage... things keep piling up in the house. log each repair with the place, status reported or booked or fixed, and cost. let me move the status along with a tap, and show what i spent this year
checklist: 1. add a repair with place, status and cost
2. button to move the status forward

row gap 2
  statcard count(repair where status != Fixed), "repairs still open"

request: kitchen pantry: rice, flour, oil, lentils, sugar. each has how many i have and a minimum. plus and minus buttons when i use or buy, red when at or below the minimum, and a short list of what to buy this week
checklist: 1. add a pantry item with quantity, unit and minimum
3. red when at or below minimum
program:
app "Pantry" food orange
table stock item text, qty num 0..500 = 1, minimum num 0..100 = 1, unit pick Kg|Pack|Litre|Piece = Pack
let low = count(stock where qty <= minimum)
topbar "Pantry", stock, "Add item"
statcard low, "items running low of" count(stock), count(stock)
each stock sort item as s empty "The pantry list is empty. Add the staples."
  row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
    stack grow gap 0
      s.item bold
      s.qty s.unit "· min" s.minimum faint color if(s.qty <= s.minimum, bad, muted)

section "To buy this week"
  each stock where qty <= minimum sort item as s empty "Nothing to buy."
    s.item "(" s.unit ")"

request: should i take the bike or the car to the office. type the distance each way, my days in office a month, fuel price and the km per litre of my vehicle, and show the fuel cost per day and per month plus the yearly cost
checklist: 5. fuel cost per day and month and year
program:
app "Commute Cost" car teal
state dist num = 14
state days_m num = 22
state fuel money = 270
state kpl num = 12
let day_cost = if(kpl > 0, dist * 2 / kpl * fuel, 0)
field dist "Distance each way (km)"
field kpl "Vehicle km per litre"
field fuel "Fuel price per litre"
"Office days per month" days_m faint
slider days_m 1..31
statcard round(day_cost), "fuel cost per day"
row gap 2
  statcard round(day_cost * days_m), "per month"
  statcard round(day_cost * days_m * 12), "per year"

request: running the street football league. every team has played some matches, i enter wins, draws, losses and goals for and against. rank the teams by points, 3 for a win and 1 for a draw, break ties on goal difference
checklist: 1. add a team with wins, draws, losses and goals
5. tap a team to change its record
program:
app "League Table" trophy orange
table team name text, won num 0.. = 0, drawn num 0.. = 0, lost num 0.. = 0, gf num 0.. = 0, ga num 0.. = 0
let pts(t team) = t.won * 3 + t.drawn
let gd(t team) = t.gf - t.ga
topbar "League Table", team, "Add team"
section "Standings", "Pts = 3 per win + 1 per draw"
  each team sort pts(it) * 1000 + gd(it) desc as t empty "No teams yet. Add the first team."
    row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
      (index + 1) bold
      t.name grow
      t.won + t.drawn + t.lost "P" faint
      gd(t) "GD" faint
      pts(t) "pts" bold
section "Points"
  share team sort pts(it) desc, pts(it), it.name

request: i have 3 tests left this term and i need an overall average of 75 percent for the scholarship. i already did 4 tests with an average of 70. what average do i need on the last three
checklist: 5. average needed on the remaining tests
program:
app "Test Average" pencil green
state done_n num = 4
state avg_so_far num = 70
state left_n num = 3
state aim num = 75
let need = if(left_n > 0, (aim * (done_n + left_n) - avg_so_far * done_n) / left_n, 0)
"Tests done" done_n faint
slider done_n 0..20
field avg_so_far "Average so far (%)"
"Tests remaining" left_n faint
slider left_n 1..10
field aim "Average I want (%)"
if need > 100
  "Out of reach" big color bad
  "You would need" round(need) "% on each remaining test." faint
else
  round(need * 10) / 10 big
  "percent average needed on each remaining test" faint
